subject: Compliance follow-up and trust locker access for Silverline Health
body:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@silverlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Compliance follow-up and trust locker access for Silverline Health

Hi Elena / Marcus — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on the compliance materials you asked for: 

Summary of ask from Silverline: 
- Primary: SOC 2 Type II report (latest period) and a signed bridge letter or interim attestation while the full report is provided.
- Secondary: Confirmments about GDPR/HIPAA scoping, data residency, and whether customer data is logged for model telemetry.
- VSQ: We'll kick off the vendor security questionnaire (you shared an initial XLS) and will need a list of owners for each control area.

What Redwood will provide (timeline estimates):
- Redwood will share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report in the trust locker within 48 hours and provide a bridge-letter template if the final report requires controls verification. (Link to locker below.)
- Security packet: evidence index, data handling summary, and high-level architecture diagram — available in the trust portal by EOD Thursday.
- VSQ response: we will start populating the Silverline_VSQ_v1.xlsx and return it for your review next week (target: 2025-11-19).

Action items and owners: 
- Aditya: provision trust locker access for Silverline and upload redacted SOC 2 Type II report (target: 48 hrs).
- Marissa: populate the architecture diagram and evidence index; follow up with security engineering for any redaction asks.
- Ben: work with solutions engineering on telemetry/data residency confirmation and add notes to the VSQ.
- Elena / Marcus: confirm primary VSQ contact for Silverline (name + email) and any additional compliance reviewers.

Attachments referenced: Silverline_VSQ_v1.xlsx (attached), Redwood_SOC2-TypeII-BridgeLetter_Template.pdf (we will tailor and sign once we confirm the report distribution policy).

Trust locker / report links (internal access control will apply):
- Trust locker request: https://trust.redwood.ai/locker/Silverline-REQ-2345
- Reference SOC 2 report (redacted): https://na1-docs.redwood.ai/portal/SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-Report-2024.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up as soon as access is provisioned.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

--

On Wed, 12 Nov 2025 at 16:12, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@silverlinehealth.com> wrote:
> From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@silverlinehealth.com>
> To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
> Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 16:12:00 -0600
> Subject: Re: Compliance follow-up and trust locker access for Silverline Health
>
> Hi Aditya — appreciate the clear recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 
>
> 1) VSQ contact: that will be me (elena.ruiz@silverlinehealth.com) and Marcus Dupree (marcus.dupree@silverlinehealth.com) will be the technical reviewer.
> 2) For the SOC 2 redaction: we cannot accept reports with customer-identifying artifacts. If you can provide a redacted PDF and then a signed bridge letter that states Redwood’s control environment has not materially changed since the report period, that will be sufficient for procurement to move forward.
> 3) Data residency: Silverline requires that PHI routing and any persistent logs for model inputs are restricted to US regions. Please confirm whether you have EU-hosted runtime options and whether logs can be disabled for our account.
>
> We have attached our VSQ v1 with two initial questions flagged (tab: Controls -> Logging).
>
> Thanks — we are aiming to have compliance cleared by end of month for the POC kickoff.
>
> Elena Ruiz
> Dir., Information Security
> Silverline Health
> 650-555-0199
>
> --

On Fri, 14 Nov 2025 at 09:23, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai> wrote:
> From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
> To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@silverlinehealth.com>, Marcus Dupree <marcus.dupree@silverlinehealth.com>
> Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
> Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 09:23:00 -0800
> Subject: Re: Compliance follow-up and trust locker access for Silverline Health
>
> Hi Elena / Marcus — looping back with the items we promised and confirming next milestone dates.
>
> 1) Trust locker: I provisioned a read-only share for elena.ruiz@silverlinehealth.com and marcus.dupree@silverlinehealth.com. You should have received an invite from trust@redwood.ai; if not, reply and I’ll re-send. Link: https://trust.redwood.ai/locker/Silverline-REQ-2345
> 2) SOC 2 Type II (redacted): uploaded a redacted PDF to the trust locker (filename: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024_redacted.pdf). We included control IDs and test descriptions but removed customer-specific evidence.
> 3) Bridge letter: attached a signed bridge-letter template (Redwood_SOC2-TypeII-BridgeLetter_Template.pdf). This is intended to accompany the redacted report for procurement review.
> 4) VSQ: Marissa and Ben started populating the Silverline_VSQ_v1.xlsx; Marissa flagged the controls related to logging and telemetry for engineering review. Expect a first-pass return by 2025-11-19.
>
> Action for Silverline: please confirm on the VSQ flagged logging items if disabling persistent model-input logs is a requirement (yes/no). If yes, we’ll route to product to scope the account-level setting and estimated timeline.
>
> If everything looks good on your end, we can schedule a short call next week (15–20 min) to walk procurement through the bridge letter and the trust locker contents. Suggested time slots: Tue 2025-11-18 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 2025-11-19 14:00–15:00 PT.
>
> Thanks — will keep you posted on any further evidence uploads.
>
> Best,
> Aditya
>
> Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-TypeII-BridgeLetter_Template.pdf (signed), Silverline_VSQ_v1.xlsx (in-progress)
